movies.overview: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.
movies.title: Halloween
movies.tagline: The night he came home!

movies.overview: A year after the murder of her mother, a teenage girl is terrorized by a masked killer who targets her and her friends by using scary movies as part of a deadly game.
movies.title: Scream
movies.tagline: Someone has taken their love of scary movies one step too far. Solving this mystery is going to be murder.

movies.overview: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before. Krueger has now come back in the dreams of his killers' children, claiming their lives as his revenge. Nancy and her boyfriend, Glen, must devise a plan to lure the monster out of the realm of nightmares and into the real world...
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
movies.tagline: If Nancy doesn't wake up screaming, she won't wake up at all.

movies.overview: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way, they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.
movies.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
movies.tagline: Who will survive and what will be left of them?

movies.overview: Camp counselors are stalked and murdered by an unknown assailant while trying to reopen a summer camp that was the site of a child's drowning.
movies.title: Friday the 13th
movies.tagline: They were warned...They are doomed...And on Friday the 13th, nothing will save them.

movies.overview: After being shot in a toy store, a serial killer transfers his soul into a Good Guy doll. A mother then gifts it to her 6-year old son Andy, which unleashes terror upon the city.
movies.title: Child's Play
movies.tagline: You'll wish it was only make-believe.

movies.overview: The early years of young Michael Myers and the events leading up to his fateful Halloween night murder rampage in the quiet town of Haddonfield, Illinois.
movies.title: Halloween
movies.tagline: Evil has a destiny.

movies.overview: When larcenous real estate clerk Marion Crane goes on the lam with a wad of cash and hopes of starting a new life, she ends up at the notorious Bates Motel, where manager Norman Bates cares for his housebound mother.
movies.title: Psycho
movies.tagline: A new and altogether different screen excitement!

movies.overview: Best friends Marie and Alexia decide to spend a quiet weekend at Alexia's parents' secluded farmhouse. But on the night of their arrival, the girls' idyllic getaway turns into an endless night of horror.
movies.title: High Tension
movies.tagline: Hearts will bleed.

movies.overview: As the residents of the Pi Kappa Sigma sorority house prepare for the festive season, a stranger begins to harass them with a series of obscene phone calls.
movies.title: Black Christmas
movies.tagline: If this picture doesn't make your skin crawl... it's on TOO TIGHT.

movies.overview: Two years after the Woodsboro murders, Sidney Prescott acclimates to college life while someone donning the Ghostface costume begins a new string of killings.
movies.title: Scream 2
movies.tagline: Someone has taken their love of sequels one step too far.

movies.overview: The Candyman, a murderous soul with a hook for a hand, is accidentally summoned to reality by a skeptic grad student researching the monster's myth.
movies.title: Candyman
movies.tagline: We dare you to say his name five times.

movies.original_title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
movies.overview: After an accident on a winding road, four teens make the fatal mistake of dumping their victim's body into the sea. Exactly one year later, the deadly secret resurfaces as they're stalked by a hook-handed figure.
movies.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
movies.tagline: If you're going to bury the truth, make sure it stays buried.

movies.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
movies.overview: A psychiatrist, familiar with the knife-wielding dream demon Freddy Krueger, helps teens at a mental hospital battle the killer who is invading their dreams.
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
movies.tagline: If you think you'll get out alive, you must be dreaming.

movies.overview: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis, Michael Myers has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.
movies.title: Halloween II
movies.tagline: More of the night he came home.

movies.overview: Based on Wes Craven's 1977 suspenseful cult classic, The Hills Have Eyes is the story of a family road trip that goes terrifyingly awry when the travelers become stranded in a government atomic zone. Miles from nowhere, the Carter family soon realizes the seemingly uninhabited wasteland is actually the breeding ground of a blood-thirsty mutant family...and they are the prey.
movies.title: The Hills Have Eyes
movies.tagline: The lucky ones die first.

movies.overview: Fifteen years after the original Woodsboro murders, Sidney Prescott returns home to promote her new book about surviving trauma, only for a new Ghostface killer to emerge, targeting a new group of teens.
movies.title: Scream 4
movies.tagline: New decade. New rules.

movies.overview: Two men wake up to find themselves shackled in a grimy, abandoned bathroom. As they struggle to comprehend their predicament, they discover a disturbing tape left behind by the sadistic mastermind known as Jigsaw. With a chilling voice and cryptic instructions, Jigsaw informs them that they must partake in a gruesome game in order to secure their freedom.
movies.title: Saw
movies.tagline: How much blood would you shed to stay alive?

movies.overview: A psychotic man, troubled by his childhood abuse, kills and mutilates young women and local models on the streets of New York City.
movies.title: Maniac
movies.tagline: I warned you not to go out tonight!

movies.overview: After a teenager has a terrifying vision of him and his friends dying in a plane crash, he prevents the accident only to have Death hunt them down, one by one.
movies.title: Final Destination
movies.tagline: No accidents. No coincidences. No escapes. You can't cheat death.

movies.overview: Laurie Strode struggles to come to terms with her brother Michael's deadly return to Haddonfield, Illinois. Meanwhile, Michael prepares for another reunion with his sister.
movies.title: Halloween II
movies.tagline: Family is forever.

movies.overview: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way, they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.
movies.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
movies.tagline: Who will survive and what will be left of them?

movies.overview: As bodies begin dropping around the Hollywood set of STAB 3, the third film based on the gruesome Woodsboro killings, Sidney and other survivors are once again terrorized by another Ghostface killer.
movies.title: Scream 3
movies.tagline: The most terrifying scream is always the last.

movies.overview: Five friends set out for a weekend at a remote cabin in the woods, expecting nothing more than fun and relaxation. As night falls, they discover that something far more unsettling is at work and that nothing about their getaway is what it seems.
movies.title: The Cabin in the Woods
movies.tagline: You think you know the story.

movies.overview: As he helps a young artist with her upcoming exhibition, the owner of a mannequin shop's deadly, suppressed desires come to the surface.
movies.title: Maniac
movies.tagline: I Warned You Not to Go Out Tonight.

movies.overview: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.
movies.title: Halloween
movies.tagline: The night he came home!

movies.overview: Two hillbillies are suspected of being killers by a group of paranoid college kids camping near the duo's West Virginian cabin. As the body count climbs, so does the fear and confusion as the college kids try to seek revenge against the pair.
movies.title: Tucker and Dale vs. Evil
movies.tagline: Evil just messed with the wrong hillbillies.

movies.overview: A college campus is plagued by a vicious serial killer murdering students in ways that correspond to various urban legends.
movies.title: Urban Legend
movies.tagline: What you don't believe can kill you.

movies.overview: Five years after the horrible bloodbath at Camp Crystal Lake, new counselors roam the area, not sensing the ominous lurking presence that proves that the grisly legend is real.
movies.title: Friday the 13th Part 2
movies.tagline: The body count continues...

movies.overview: When the Davison family comes under attack during their wedding anniversary getaway, the gang of mysterious killers soon learns that one of their victims harbors a secret talent for fighting back.
movies.title: You're Next
movies.tagline: Did you remember to lock your door?

movies.overview: On a desolate country highway, two homeward-bound teens are nearly run off the road by a maniac in a beat-up truck, and later spot him shoving what appears to be a body down a sewer pipe.
movies.title: Jeepers Creepers
movies.tagline: What's eating you?

movies.overview: While a group of young actors rehearse a new musical about a mass murderer, a notorious psychopath escapes from a nearby insane asylum.
movies.title: Stage Fright
movies.tagline: Theatre of Delirium.

movies.overview: Austin's hottest DJ, Jungle Julia, sets out into the night to unwind with her two friends Shanna and Arlene. Covertly tracking their moves is Stuntman Mike, a scarred rebel leering from behind the wheel of his muscle car, revving just feet away.
movies.title: Death Proof
movies.tagline: A crash course in revenge.

movies.overview: A young woman is followed by an unknown supernatural force after a sexual encounter.
movies.title: It Follows
movies.tagline: It doesn't think, it doesn't feel, it doesn't give up.

movies.overview: Freddy Krueger and Jason Voorhees return to terrorize the teenagers of Elm Street. Only this time, they're out to get each other, too.
movies.title: Freddy vs. Jason
movies.tagline: Even a killer has something to fear.

movies.overview: Chris crashes into a carload of other young people, and the group of stranded motorists is soon lost in the woods of West Virginia, where they're hunted by three cannibalistic mountain men who are grossly disfigured by generations of inbreeding.
movies.title: Wrong Turn
movies.tagline: It's the last one you'll ever take.

movies.overview: Teenagers Nancy, Quentin, Kris, Jesse and Dean are all neighborhood friends who begin having the same dream of a horribly disfigured man who wears a tattered sweater and a glove made of knives. The man terrorizes them in their dreams, and the only escape is to wake up. But when, one by one, they start dying violently, the friends realize that what happens in the dream world is real, and the only way to stay alive is to stay awake.
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
movies.tagline: Welcome to your new nightmare.

movies.overview: Years after a terrible boating accident, Angela is sent to Camp Arawak where a series of bizarre and violent "accidents" begin to claim the lives of various campers.
movies.title: Sleepaway Camp
movies.tagline: …you won't be coming home!

movies.overview: Released from captivity in Vietnam, two American Army officers return to civilian life and discover they have acquired an insatiable taste for human flesh. A city is terrorised... as they stalk the inhabitants to satisfy their primitive appetites.
movies.title: Cannibal Apocalypse
movies.tagline: POW's in Vietnam... starved in captivity... released with a taste for human flesh.

movies.overview: A group of unwitting teens are stranded near a strange wax museum and soon must fight to survive and keep from becoming the next exhibit.
movies.title: House of Wax
movies.tagline: Prey. Slay. Display.

movies.original_title: Jason Lives - Friday the 13th Part VI
movies.overview: Tommy Jarvis, tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn't really dead, unwittingly resurrects the mass murderer for another bloody rampage.
movies.title: Jason Lives - Friday the 13th Part VI
movies.tagline: Kill or be killed.

movies.overview: When a young couple goes to a remote wooded lake for a romantic getaway, their quiet weekend is shattered by an aggressive group of local kids. Rowdiness quickly turns to rage as the teens terrorize the couple in unimaginable ways, and a weekend outing becomes a bloody battle for survival.
movies.title: Eden Lake
movies.tagline: A weekend by the lake, with views to die for.

movies.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
movies.overview: A teenage boy is haunted in his dreams by deceased child murderer Freddy Krueger, who is out to possess him in order to continue his reign of terror in the real world.
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
movies.tagline: The man of your dreams is back.

movies.overview: A demonic force has chosen Freddy Krueger as its portal to the real world. Can Heather Langenkamp play the part of Nancy one last time and trap the evil trying to enter our world?
movies.title: New Nightmare
movies.tagline: This time the terror doesn't stop at the screen.

movies.overview: Chucky is reborn when his old flame, Tiffany, rescues his battered doll parts from a police impound.
movies.title: Bride of Chucky
movies.tagline: Chucky gets lucky.

movies.overview: When one of them breaks a leg, five friends snowboarding in the Norwegian mountains take shelter in an abandoned ski lodge and soon realize they’re not alone.
movies.title: Cold Prey
movies.tagline: You'll Catch Your Death.

movies.overview: Caught in a bizarre and terrifying time warp, college student Tree finds herself repeatedly reliving the day of her murder, ultimately realizing that she must identify the killer and the reason for her death before her chances of survival run out.
movies.title: Happy Death Day
movies.tagline: Get up. Live your day. Get killed. Again.

movies.overview: After his revival in a hospital morgue, Jason fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.
movies.title: Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter
movies.tagline: Three times before you have felt the terror, known the madness, lived the horror. But this is the one you've been screaming for.

movies.overview: In 1979, a group of young filmmakers set out to make an adult film in rural Texas, but when their reclusive, elderly hosts catch them in the act, the cast find themselves fighting for their lives.
movies.title: X
movies.tagline: Dying to show you a good time.

movies.original_title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Beginning
movies.overview: Chrissie and her friends set out on a road trip for a final fling before one is shipped off to Vietnam. Along the way, bikers harass the foursome and cause an accident that throws Chrissie from the vehicle. The lawman who arrives on the scene kills one of the bikers and brings Chrissie's friends to the Hewitt homestead, where young Leatherface is learning the tools of terror.
movies.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Beginning
movies.tagline: What you know about fear... doesn't even come close.

movies.overview: A familiar-looking group of teenagers find themselves being stalked by a more-than-vaguely recognizable masked killer! As the victims begin to pile up and the laughs pile on, none of your favorite scary movies escape the razor-sharp satire of this outrageously funny parody!
movies.title: Scary Movie
movies.tagline: No mercy. No shame. No sequel.

movies.overview: A young woman grieving the loss of her mother, a famous scream queen from the 1980s, finds herself pulled into the world of her mom's most famous movie. Reunited, the women must fight off the film's maniacal killer.
movies.title: The Final Girls
movies.tagline: Who will survive?

movies.overview: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former baby sitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason.
movies.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
movies.tagline: This summer, terror won't be taking a vacation.

movies.overview: A caretaker at a summer camp is burned when a prank goes tragically wrong. After several years of intensive treatment at hospital, he is released back into society, albeit missing some social skills. What follows is a bloody killing spree with the caretaker making his way back to his old stomping ground to confront one of the youths that accidentally burned him.
movies.title: The Burning
movies.tagline: A legend of terror isn't a campfire story anymore!

movies.overview: A group of young adults visit a boarded up campsite named Crystal Lake where they soon encounter the mysterious Jason Voorhees and his deadly intentions.
movies.title: Friday the 13th
movies.tagline: Welcome to Crystal Lake.

movies.overview: Chucky is reconstructed by a toy factory to dispel the negative publicity surrounding the doll, and tracks young Andy Barclay to a foster home where the chase begins again.
movies.title: Child's Play 2
movies.tagline: Sorry Jack... Chucky's back!

movies.overview: The murderous, backwoods Firefly family take to the road to escape the vengeful Sheriff Wydell, who is not afraid of being as ruthless as his target.
movies.title: The Devil's Rejects
movies.tagline: This summer, go to hell.

movies.overview: Three backpackers stranded in the Australian outback are plunged inside a hellish nightmare of insufferable torture by a sadistic psychopathic local.
movies.title: Wolf Creek
movies.tagline: The thrill is in the hunt.

movies.overview: When Kimberly has a violent premonition of a highway pileup she blocks the freeway, keeping a few others meant to die, safe...Or are they? The survivors mysteriously start dying and it's up to Kimberly to stop it before she's next.
movies.title: Final Destination 2
movies.tagline: For every beginning there is an end.

movies.overview: In 1979, a group of college students find a Sumerian Book of the Dead in an old wilderness cabin they've rented for a weekend getaway.
movies.title: The Evil Dead
movies.tagline: The ultimate experience in gruelling terror.

movies.overview: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a new killer has donned the Ghostface mask and begins targeting a group of teenagers to resurrect secrets from the town’s deadly past.
movies.title: Scream
movies.tagline: It's always someone you know.

movies.overview: Two teenage couples traveling across the backwoods of Texas searching for urban legends of serial killers end up as prisoners of a bizarre and sadistic backwater family of serial killers.
movies.title: House of 1000 Corpses
movies.tagline: The most shocking tale of carnage ever seen.

movies.original_title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
movies.overview: Beautiful Mandy Lane isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man, the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet, keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.
movies.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
movies.tagline: Everyone is dying to be with her. Someone is killing for it.

movies.overview: A radio host is victimised by the notorious cannibal family while a former Texas Marshal hunts them.
movies.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2
movies.tagline: After a decade of silence... the buzzz is back.

movies.overview: Complete strangers stranded at a remote desert motel during a raging storm soon find themselves the target of a deranged murderer. As their numbers thin out, the travelers begin to turn on each other, as each tries to figure out who the killer is.
movies.title: Identity
movies.tagline: The secret lies within.

movies.overview: Following the latest Ghostface killings, the four survivors leave Woodsboro behind and start a fresh chapter.
movies.title: Scream VI
movies.tagline: New York. New rules.

movies.overview: On a stormy night, young Jim, who transports a luxury car from Chicago to California to deliver it to its owner, feeling tired and sleepy, picks up a mysterious hitchhiker, who has appeared out of nowhere, thinking that a good conversation will help him not to fall asleep. He will have enough time to deeply regret such an unmeditated decision.
movies.title: The Hitcher
movies.tagline: The terror starts the moment he stops.

movies.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master
movies.overview: Freddy Krueger returns once again to terrorize the dreams of the remaining Dream Warriors, as well as those of a young woman who may be able to defeat him for good.
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master
movies.tagline: Terror beyond your wildest dreams.

movies.overview: Desperate to repay his debt to his ex-wife, an ex-con plots a heist at his new employer's country home, unaware that a second criminal has also targeted the property, and rigged it with a series of deadly traps.
movies.title: The Collector
movies.tagline: He always takes one

movies.overview: When some very creepy things start happening around school, the kids at Herrington High make the chilling discovery that confirms their worst suspicions: their teachers really are from another planet!
movies.title: The Faculty
movies.tagline: These six students are about to discover their teachers really are from another planet.

movies.original_title: I Still Know What You Did Last Summer
movies.overview: Ever since killing the Fisherman one year ago, Julie James is still haunted by images of him after her. When her best friend Karla wins free tickets to the Bahamas, Julie finds this a perfect opportunity to finally relax. But someone is waiting for her. Someone who she thought was dead. Someone who is out again for revenge.
movies.title: I Still Know What You Did Last Summer
movies.tagline: Someone is dying for a second chance.

movies.overview: A group of teens break into a blind man's home thinking they'll get away with the perfect crime. They're wrong.
movies.title: Don't Breathe
movies.tagline: This house looked like an easy target, until they found what was inside.

movies.overview: A killer dressed in a police uniform begins murdering innocent people on the streets of New York City.
movies.title: Maniac Cop
movies.tagline: You Have The Right To Remain Silent... Forever.

movies.overview: Three backpackers head to a Slovakian city that promises to meet their hedonistic expectations, with no idea of the hell that awaits them.
movies.title: Hostel
movies.tagline: Welcome to your worst nightmare.

movies.overview: Twenty years after a Valentine's Day tragedy claimed the lives of five miners, Harry Warden returns for a vengeful massacre among teen sweethearts gearing up for another party.
movies.title: My Bloody Valentine
movies.tagline: There's more than one way to lose your heart...

movies.overview: An idyllic summer turns into a nightmare of unspeakable terror for yet another group of naïve friends. Ignoring Camp Crystal Lake's bloody legacy, one by one they fall victim to the maniacal Jason, who stalks them at every turn...
movies.title: Friday the 13th Part III
movies.tagline: A New Dimension In Terror...

movies.original_title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
movies.overview: Ten years after his original massacre, the invalid Michael Myers awakens on Halloween Eve and returns to Haddonfield to kill his seven-year-old niece.
movies.title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
movies.tagline: Ten years ago he changed the face of Halloween. Tonight, HE'S BACK.

movies.overview: In the year 2455, Old Earth is now a contaminated planet abandoned for centuries -- a brown world of violent storms, toxic landmasses and poisonous seas. Yet humans have returned to the deadly place that they once fled, not to live, but to research the ancient, rusting artifacts of the long-gone civilizations. But it's not the harmful environment that could prove fatal to the intrepid, young explorers who have just landed on Old Earth. For them, it's Friday the 13th, and Jason lives!
movies.title: Jason X
movies.tagline: Evil gets an upgrade.

movies.overview: A year after the Miles County massacre, Art the Clown is resurrected by a sinister entity. Art returns home, where he must hunt down and destroy teenage Sienna and her younger brother Jonathan on Halloween. As the body count rises, the siblings fight to stay alive while uncovering the true nature of Art's evil intent.
movies.title: Terrifier 2
movies.tagline: Who's laughing now?

movies.overview: When Jess sets sail on a yacht with a group of friends, she cannot shake the feeling that there is something wrong.
movies.title: Triangle
movies.tagline: Terror comes in waves

movies.overview: A maniacal clown named Art terrorizes three young women on Halloween night and everyone else who stands in his way.
movies.title: Terrifier
movies.tagline: You never forget your first kill.

movies.overview: Seven employees of an international weapons manufacturer are treated to a team-building weekend at the company’s newly built luxury spa lodge. Things quickly go awry as the colleagues find their corporate weekend sabotaged by a deadly enemy.
movies.title: Severance
movies.tagline: Another bloody office outing.

movies.overview: Alice is a withdrawn 12-year-old who lives with her mother and her younger sister, Karen, who gets most of the attention from her mother, leaving Alice out of the spotlight. When Karen is found brutally murdered in a church, suspicions start to turn toward Alice. But could a 12-year-old girl really be capable of such savagery?
movies.title: Alice, Sweet Alice
movies.tagline: If you survive this night... nothing will scare you again.

movies.overview: Five years after surviving Art the Clown's Halloween massacre, Sienna and Jonathan are still struggling to rebuild their shattered lives. As the holiday season approaches, they try to embrace the Christmas spirit and leave the horrors of the past behind. But just when they think they're safe, Art returns, determined to turn their holiday cheer into a new nightmare. The festive season quickly unravels as Art unleashes his twisted brand of terror, proving that no holiday is safe.
movies.title: Terrifier 3
movies.tagline: Prepare to be terrified again.

movies.overview: A woman will go to whatever lengths necessary to obtain her dream home with a view of the sea. This includes driving down the property value and decreasing the occupancy rate by killing her potential neighbors.
movies.title: Dream Home
movies.tagline: In a cut-throat property market, she'd kill for a harbour view.

movies.overview: Taking an ill-advised detour en-route to California, the Carter family soon run into trouble when their RV breaks down in the middle of the desert. Stranded, they find themselves at the mercy of monstrous cannibals lurking in the surrounding hills.
movies.title: The Hills Have Eyes
movies.tagline: The lucky ones died first...

movies.overview: As a killer named Cinderhella stalks the student body at the high school in Grizzly Lake, a group of co-eds band together to survive while they're all serving detention.
movies.title: Detention
movies.tagline: Cancel Your Future

movies.overview: Lured by the promise of an Australian holiday, backpackers Rutger, Katarina and Paul visit the notorious Wolf Creek Crater.  Their dream Outback adventure soon becomes a horrific reality when they encounter the site's most infamous local, the last man any traveller to the region ever wants to meet—Mick Taylor.  As the backpackers flee, Mick pursues them on an epic white knuckled rampage across hostile wasteland.
movies.title: Wolf Creek 2
movies.tagline: The outback can be crazy this time of year.

movies.original_title: Friday the 13th Part VII - The New Blood
movies.overview: Tina Shepard, a telekinetic teenage girl, accidentally unchains Jason from his watery grave, allowing him to go on another killing spree in the area.
movies.title: Friday the 13th Part VII - The New Blood
movies.tagline: On Friday the 13th, Jason is back. But this time someone's waiting.

movies.overview: A deaf woman is stalked by a psychotic killer in her secluded home.
movies.title: Hush
movies.tagline: Silence can be killer.

movies.original_title: The Last House on the Left
movies.overview: When athletic teen Mari Collingwood opts to hang out with her friend Paige in town rather than spend an evening in with her parents vacationing at the family's remote lake house, it marks the beginning of a night no one is going to forget.
movies.title: The Last House on the Left
movies.tagline: If bad people hurt someone you love, how far would you go to hurt them back?

movies.original_title: Behind the Mask: The Rise of Leslie Vernon
movies.overview: The next great psycho horror slasher has given a documentary crew exclusive access to his life as he plans his reign of terror over the sleepy town of Glen Echo, all the while deconstructing the conventions and archetypes of the horror genre for them.
movies.title: Behind the Mask: The Rise of Leslie Vernon
movies.tagline: Freddy, Jason, Michael. We All Need Someone To Look Up To.

movies.overview: As soon as Muffy St. John and her college friends arrive on her parents' secluded island, someone starts trimming the guest list... one murder at a time.
movies.title: April Fool's Day
movies.tagline: Guess who's going to be the life of the party?

movies.overview: In 1978, two rival groups at Camp Nightwing must band together to solve a terrifying mystery when horrors from their towns' history come alive.
movies.title: Fear Street: 1978
movies.tagline: Find the truth.

movies.overview: Four friends start to receive morbid Valentine cards and realise they are being stalked by someone they had spurned 13 years ago. A masked killer is on the loose and Valentine's day is soon approaching.
movies.title: Valentine
movies.tagline: Remember that kid everyone ignored on Valentine’s Day? He remembers you.

movies.overview: When the senior sorority sisters of Theta Pi decide to do in their demented house mother, someone seeks revenge, and begins a night of terror and madness.
movies.title: The House on Sorority Row
movies.tagline: Sorority sisters... Sisters in life. Sisters in death.

movies.overview: Michael manages to free himself from Laurie Strode's trap to resume his ritual bloodbath. As she fights for her life from injuries from their last encounter, she inspires her daughter Karen, her granddaughter Allyson, and all of Haddonfield to rise up against the unstoppable monster.
movies.title: Halloween Kills
movies.tagline: Evil dies tonight.

movies.overview: At a high school senior prom, a masked killer stalks four teenagers who were responsible for the accidental death of a classmate six years prior.
movies.title: Prom Night
movies.tagline: If you're not back by midnight... you won't be coming home!

movies.overview: A student babysitter has her evening disturbed when the phone rings. So begins a series of increasingly terrifying and threatening calls that lead to a shocking revelation.
movies.title: When a Stranger Calls
movies.tagline: Every babysitter's nightmare becomes real...

movies.overview: When a group of tourists on a New Orleans haunted swamp tour find themselves stranded in the wilderness, their evening of fun and spooks turns into a horrific nightmare.
movies.title: Hatchet
